title: Legal Is Not Good: A Pre-Registered Benchmark of Low-Cost Language and Decision Models on a New Strategy Game

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We carry the method to a second, very different domain, a turn-based strategy game, and ask a deliberately modest question: how well do low-cost agents play under a pre-registered protocol? hexfolk is a minimal two-player 4X game written for this purpose, so no model has seen its rules or positions.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: A deterministic engine, one agent interface, a referee that never corrects an illegal or late move, and per-decision logs make every game replayable; questions and expected answers were committed before the games, on held-out seeds with mirrored seats and 95% Wilson intervals.

evidence.label: 材料中提供代码或数据链接（未核验内容）

declaredVenue: 14 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Pre-registered protocol (v1-v5, all amendments committed before the games they govern). Engine, benchmark harness, agents and protocol: https://github.com/federicolucca/hexfolk, tag bench-v1. Companion to arXiv:2610.32955 and arXiv:2611.21393. No frontier model; paid pairings limited to 50 games by budget
